Applications must be submitted online on or before 24-10-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of SMC to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.

content_sections.heading: SMC Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the SMC Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download SMC Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Sports Coach: Passed NIS or equivalent diploma/course from Sports Authority of India (6 months course) and at least one year of coaching experience OR B.P.Ed / D.P.Ed / M.P.Ed qualification and physically fit PT teacher OR H.S.C. pass with participation in national/state level in relevant sports or 2 years coaching experience.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: Sports Coach: Maximum age limit is 50 years.

content_sections.heading: Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Sports Coach: Rs. 10,000/- per month fix.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Online Application submission Document Verification / Walk-in-Interview

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the SMC Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 24-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of SMC to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Surat Municipal Corporation (SMC) to fill vacancies for Honorary Coaches in newly constructed sports complexes.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 8 vacancies available for various sports posts under this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q3. What posts are available under SMC Honorary Coach Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The posts include Table Tennis, Badminton, Volleyball, Kho-Kho, Kabaddi, Judo, Karate, and Gym Coaches.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for the Honorary Coach position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a fixed salary of Rs. 10,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification required for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an NIS Certified or equivalent degree/diploma, B.P.Ed/M.P.Ed, or relevant sports participation at the National/State level with coaching experience.

faq.question: Q6. What is the maximum age limit to apply?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 50 years.

faq.question: Q7. When does the online application process start and end?
faq.answer: The online application process starts on 15-10-2026 and concludes on 24-10-2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted through online mode by visiting the official Surat Municipal Corporation website.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for SMC Honorary Coach recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises online application submission followed by document verification and a walk-in-interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I access the official website to apply?
faq.answer: You can access the official website at https://www.suratmunicipal.gov.in to complete your online application registration.
